title: Log in successfully and reach the authenticated app
description: This test verifies that a user can submit valid credentials on the login page and enter the authenticated area with access to the app shell.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username or email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the user lands in the authenticated app
Verify access to the dashboard is available

title: Block direct access to the dashboard when signed out
description: This test verifies that an unauthenticated visitor who opens the dashboard is redirected or blocked from protected content.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Verify the login page is displayed

title: Block direct access to protected management pages when signed out
description: This test verifies that an unauthenticated visitor who opens protected management pages is redirected or blocked from access.

steps.description: Navigate to /projects
Verify the login page is displayed
Navigate to /dispatch
Verify the login page is displayed
Navigate to /users
Verify the login page is displayed

title: Edit a dispatch item and see the updated information
description: This test verifies that an authenticated user can change a dispatch record and see the updated dispatch information reflected in the UI.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username or email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the dispatch link in the authenticated app
Open a dispatch item for editing
Update the dispatch item details
Save the dispatch item
Verify the updated dispatch information is displayed

title: Edit a dispatch item while offline and verify sync
description: This test verifies that an authenticated user can edit a dispatch record while offline, see the offline banner, and then have it sync when online.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username or email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the dispatch link in the authenticated app
Disable network connection to simulate offline mode
Open a dispatch item for editing
Update the dispatch item details
Save the dispatch item
Verify the offline banner is visible indicating changes are saved locally
Verify the updated dispatch information is displayed in the list
Re-enable network connection to simulate online mode
Verify the changes sync to the server successfully
